title.zh: 伊朗紧张局势推升油价至$90 以上，美股期货基本未变
title.en: Wall Street futures little changed as Iran tensions lift oil prices to $90+ territory

summary.en: U.S. futures flat after three straight losing sessions, with geopolitical tensions from Iran offsetting AI sector optimism. Oil surges past $90 as yields climb, creating headwinds for rate-sensitive growth stocks.
summary.zh: 美股期货在连续三天下跌后横盘，伊朗紧张局势抵消了 AI 板块乐观情绪。油价飙升突破$90，收益率攀升对利率敏感的成长股构成压力。

title.zh: 油价飙升突破$90，美伊紧张局势升级；期指下跌
title.en: Oil Surges Above $90 as US-Iran Tensions Flare Up; Futures Drop

summary.en: US-Iran tensions spike oil above $90 and push yields higher, weighing on tech-heavy futures across the board. Weak opening sentiment as investors price-in inflation risks from energy markets before September begins.
summary.zh: 美伊紧张局势推升油价突破$90、收益率走高，拖累以科技股为主的期货整体走弱。市场在关注能源板块通胀风险的情况下展开9月交易。

title.zh: 美债收益率维持稳定，市场等待 9 月数据发布
title.en: Treasury Yields Hold Steady as Markets Await September Data

summary.en: US markets closed Friday with mixed sentiment ahead of September's economic data calendar. Pre-market attention focuses on Fed speaker expectations, Treasury yield stability, and positioning around upcoming earnings season. Geopolitical tensions continue to influence oil prices and inflation expectations.
summary.zh: 美国股市周五收盘呈现混合情绪，9 月经济数据日历在即。盘前关注焦点在于联储讲话预期、美债收益率稳定以及围绕即将展开的财报季的配置。地缘政治紧张局势继续影响油价和通胀预期。

title.zh: AI 反弹中，芯片股继续跑赢大科技
title.en: Chipmakers are outshining Big Tech in the AI rally

summary.en: AI-led buying is still carrying the tape, with Nasdaq futures outperforming as chip momentum rolls through the supply chain. But higher Treasury yields, a firmer dollar, and weaker gold show the market is still pricing a hawkish Jackson Hole backdrop rather than a clean risk-on breakout.
summary.zh: AI 仍然是盘面的主导线，纳指期货领涨，资金正沿着芯片和数据中心供应链扩散。但美债收益率更高、美元更强、黄金走弱，说明市场交易的仍是偏鹰的 Jackson Hole 背景，而不是干净利落的 风险偏好回升 突破。

title.zh: Nvidia 亮眼财报重新点燃 AI 交易
title.en: Nvidia's blockbuster results refuel the AI trade

summary.en: Nvidia's blockbuster results reignited the AI trade and pushed Nasdaq futures sharply higher, but the tape is still carrying a sticky July PCE print and Jackson Hole risk in the background. Treasury yields are softer and oil is sliding on Middle East de-escalation hopes, so the setup is risk-on for semis and mega-cap tech but still event-driven rather than cleanly bullish.
summary.zh: Nvidia 强劲的财报与指引重新点燃了 AI 交易，并推动纳指期货明显走高，但粘性的 7 月 PCE 和 Jackson Hole 风险仍在背景中压着市场。美债收益率回落、油价因中东降温预期下跌，所以当前更像半导体和大科技领涨的事件驱动型偏多环境，而不是干净的全面 风险偏好回升。

title.zh: NVIDIA 发布 Q2 FY27 财报，指引营收接近 910 亿美元，AI 芯片需求激增
title.en: NVIDIA Reports Q2 FY27 Earnings, Guidance Near $91B Revenue as AI Chip Demand Surges

summary.en: Markets eye NVIDIA's Q2 earnings report and July PCE inflation data, with Dow futures rising while Nasdaq slips ahead of AI chip giant results. Oil prices soften on constructive Oman-Iran talks easing Hormuz Strait concerns, while Treasury yields edge higher ahead of Fed's preferred inflation gauge release. Geopolitical developments in Middle East continue to drive cross-asset transmission from energy to inflation expectations.
summary.zh: 市场聚焦 NVIDIA 第二季财报和七月 PCE 通胀数据，道指期货上涨而纳斯达克下跌以等待 AI 芯片巨头业绩。油价因阿曼伊朗对话缓和霍尔木兹海峡担忧而回落，美债收益率在美联储偏好通胀指标发布前小幅走高。中东地缘政治发展继续驱动能源向通胀预期的跨资产传导。

title.zh: NVIDIA 在周三财报前反弹，零售投资者乐观情绪增强
title.en: Nvidia Rebounds Pre-earnings as Retail Bullish Sentiment Builds Ahead of High-Stakes Wednesday Report

summary.en: US stock futures edge higher pre-market as tech stocks rebound from Monday's selloff, led by Nvidia ahead of its high-stakes Wednesday earnings report. Investors are cautiously optimistic despite pending inflation (PCE) and GDP data releases Tuesday.
summary.zh: 继周一抛售后，科技股在英伟达带领下反弹，美股期货盘前小幅走高。市场关注英伟达周三的财报，以及即将公布的 PCE 通胀和 GDP 数据，情绪谨慎乐观。

title.zh: 美债 TGA 回购计划可能协助为债券操作融资，尽管收益率仍高企
title.en: Treasury TGA Buyback Plan Could Help Fund Bond Operations Amid Yields

summary.en: US futures pared losses as Treasury yields moderated following reports that the Treasury could use its General Account for bond buybacks. Markets await Iran sanctions details, with WTI oil dropping to $85.65 amid geopolitical uncertainty.
summary.zh: 美股期货收窄跌幅。报道称美国财政部可能动用财政部一般账户回购国债，美债收益率涨势随之缓和。市场等待伊朗制裁细节，WTI 原油在地缘局势未明之际回落至 85.65 美元。

title.zh: 国债收益率获支撑，投资者关注明日 PCE 通胀数据
title.en: Treasury Yield Relief Continues as Fed Watchers Monitor PCE Release Tomorrow

summary.en: US futures track flat after Friday's close amid stagflation regime concerns; Treasury buybacks support longer end but oil near $90 keeps inflation expectations elevated. Tech sector lags on macro headwinds while biotech and energy provide sectoral divergence.
summary.zh: 美股期货在周五收盘后持平，滞胀格局担忧弥漫；美国财政部回购国债，为长端债市提供支撑但近 90 美元油价令通胀预期居高不下。科技板块受宏观逆风拖累，而生物技术和能源提供板块分化。

title.zh: Moderna 黑色素瘤疫苗通过三期试验，股价飙升 177%
title.en: Moderna's Melanoma Vaccine Passes Phase 3 Trial, Stock Soars 177%

summary.en: US futures steady after Asian tech selloff as Treasury buybacks calm long-end yields. Moderna surges 177% on melanoma vaccine breakthrough while oil climbs near $92 amid Hormuz tensions. DXY slips below 99, gold rallies toward $4,500.
summary.zh: 美股期货在亚洲科技股抛售后企稳，美国财政部回购国债，长端收益率趋稳。Moderna 因黑色素瘤疫苗突破飙升 177%，油价受霍尔木兹海峡紧张局势影响升至近 92 美元。美元指数跌破 99，黄金反弹至 4500 美元附近。

title.zh: 特朗普称'没有讨论'伊朗和平谈判停滞——油价连续 4 日上涨
title.en: Iran Peace Talks Stall as Trump Says 'No Discussions' — Oil Rises for 4th Day

summary.en: U.S. stock futures mixed Wednesday as investors digest fading Iran peace prospects lifting oil and yields, while crowded AI chip trades unwind amid sector rotation into capacity validation themes. Broad market remains cautious with tech sector under pressure from valuation concerns and rising rate environment.
summary.zh: 美股期货周三涨跌不一，投资者消化伊朗和平前景减弱推高油价和美债收益率，同时拥挤的 AI 芯片交易因板块轮动至产能验证主题而平仓。大盘保持谨慎态度，科技股受制于估值担忧和上升利率环境承压。

title.zh: 纳斯达克期货因 AI 芯片需求乐观情绪上涨 0.3%
title.en: Nasdaq Futures Rise 0.3% on AI Chip Demand Optimism

summary.en: US equity futures flat to slightly elevated as pre-market AI and semiconductor stocks show selective strength. Fed rate decision probability remains low at 30%, supporting growth stock valuations despite mixed macro signals. Oil holds above $82 on Middle East geopolitical concerns, keeping energy sector under risk premium.
summary.zh: 美股期指早盘平稳至微幅上涨，盘前 AI 和半导体股票表现分化。美联储加息概率保持低位 30%，支撑成长股估值尽管宏观信号混杂。油价维持在 82 美元以上受中东地缘担忧影响，能源板块承受风险溢价。

title.zh: 纳斯达克期货上涨 0.52%，AI 热潮因英伟达 IPO 乐观情绪加速
title.en: Nasdaq Futures Rise 0.52% as AI Rally Accelerates on Anthropic IPO Optimism

summary.en: US equity futures mixed as pre-market AI enthusiasm drives Nasdaq significantly while Dow lags. Fed rate hike odds drop to 30%, easing yield pressures. Oil nears $90 amid stalled Iran peace talks, keeping energy sector under geopolitical premium.
summary.zh: 美股期指早盘分化，AI 热潮推动纳斯达克大幅上涨，而道指表现滞后。美联储加息概率降至 30%，缓解收益率压力。油价接近 90 美元，伊朗停火谈判停滞使能源板块承受地缘溢价。

title.zh: 油价上涨：伊朗霍尔木兹海峡紧张局势升级
title.en: Oil Climbs on Iran's Hormuz Standoff – What to Watch Today

summary.en: US futures trade mixed ahead of Friday's open as oil prices climb on geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and Iran, while AI-driven mega-cap gains offset broader concerns about inflation sticky bits. PPI data due later this week could push Fed rate cut odds higher or lower depending on print.
summary.zh: 周五开盘前美股期货分化，受中东和伊朗地缘政治紧张局势推动油价上涨，AI 驱动的大型科技股收益抵消了对通胀粘性的担忧。本周稍后发布的 PPI 数据将根据实际数值推高或压低美联储降息预期。

title.zh: 英伟达和超微电子盈利预期推动半导体板块乐观情绪，尽管面临贸易战逆风
title.en: NVIDIA and AMD Earnings Anticipation Drives Semiconductor Sector Optimism Despite Trade War Headwinds

summary.en: Pre-market attention centers on AI chip demand resilience amid trade tensions and earnings expectations for major tech names. Oil prices remain under geopolitical watch as Middle East dynamics influence energy sector positioning ahead of U.S. session open.
summary.zh: 盘前关注焦点在于贸易紧张局势下人工智能芯片需求的韧性以及主要科技股盈利预期。油价受中东地缘政治动态影响，在能源板块配置方面保持观望态度，等待美盘开盘。

title.zh: 三大指数期货在 CPI 发布前上涨
title.en: All Three Major Index Futures Rise Ahead of CPI Release

summary.en: U.S. futures rally ahead of CPI report with all three major indexes ticking higher; oil remains elevated near $84 supporting energy sector, while AI chip earnings uncertainty creates mixed sentiment in big tech names.
summary.zh: CPI 报告公布前，美股期货盘前上涨，三大指数均走高；油价维持在$84 附近支撑能源板块，AI 芯片财报不确定性导致大科技股情绪分化。

title.zh: 油价跌破 80 美元，海湾和平预期升温
title.en: Oil Prices Slide Below $80 as Gulf Peace Hopes Rise

summary.en: U.S. stocks opened mixed as geopolitical tensions over the Iran Strait of Hormuz eased oil prices, while tech sector showed divergence amid AI chip narrative debates and earnings season noise.
summary.zh: 美股盘前表现分化：随着伊朗霍尔木兹海峡地缘紧张局势缓和导致油价回落，科技股在 AI 芯片叙事争论和财报季噪音中呈现不同走势。

title.zh: 特朗普转向经济施压，伊朗对霍尔木兹海峡立场强硬化
title.en: Trump signals shift to economic pressure as Iran hardens stance over Strait of Hormuz

summary.en: Geopolitical tensions over Strait of Hormuz dominate pre-market, with Trump's shifting stance on oil majors and Iran negotiations creating cross-asset uncertainty. Oil prices surge as market weighs strike cessation prospects against geopolitical escalation risks.
summary.zh: 霍尔木兹海峡地缘紧张主导盘前交易，特朗普对石油巨头立场转变及伊朗谈判进展引发跨资产不确定性。油价在停火前景与地缘升级风险间博弈后大涨。
